explanation: The Almighty Creator who gives us power through His glory and knowledge, so that we may share in the divine nature.
Deep understanding of God and His will, gained by knowing Him personally.
The free gift from God's power that provides us with everything needed for life and godliness.
The divine strength that enables believers to overcome the pull of sin.
The necessary qualities or foundations a Christian must have in order to grow in faith.
The act of adding important virtues, so that one does not become lazy or unfruitful in service.
Trust and conviction in God's promises as the foundation for all other Christian qualities.
Moral strength and goodness manifested through actions in harmony with God's will.
The ability to distinguish between right and wrong, gained through studying the Scriptures and experiencing God.
The capacity to control one's own impulses, desires, and feelings in line with God's arrangement.
The ability to endure difficulties or suffering without losing faith in God.
Deep respect for God expressed through a holy lifestyle and reverence.
A loving attitude toward other people, especially members of the Christian community.
The highest virtue that binds everything together; God's own nature expressed through care for others.
Participation in the divine qualities of God, so that believers become holy and free from the power of sin.
The earthly desires that lead away from God and destroy the Christian awakening.
A life characterized by good deeds and growth in the knowledge of God, as opposed to being sluggish or blind.
A secure position in Christ that ensures one will not fall away from the faith.
The door into the eternal kingdom with our Lord Jesus Christ, opened for those who live according to God's order.
